install: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y git curl ca-certificates); export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; fi; if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ "$(go env GOVERSION 2>/dev/null)" != go1.25* ]]; then curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.25.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz | sudo tar -C /usr/local -xz; fi; cd /workspace && bun install'
